module: Monitors the road sections of a rally loop: if the player triggers too many route recalculations within a time window (leaves the road section route), a "liaison_deviation" penalty is recorded with the manager. Penalties escalate: 30 s, 60 s, 120 s, 180 s.
notes: Constants: window RECALC_TIME_WINDOW = 10 s, threshold RECALC_THRESHOLD = 5 recalculations, MAX_VIOLATIONS = 1.

With MAX_VIOLATIONS = 1, onUpdate triggers only one violation per instance (condition violationCount < 1), so in practice only the 30 s penalty is applied; the 60/120/180 s tiers are never reached by onUpdate.
The module returns a constructor: require('gameplay_rally_loop_roadSectionPenaltyKeeper')(manager). Time comes from manager.clock.

C.desc: Road section penalty detector. Fields: manager, recalcCount, violationCount, lastCheckTime.

init.desc: Stores the manager and resets the counters. Called by the constructor.

registerRecalc.desc: Increments the route recalculation counter; call it on each detected route recalculation.

createPenaltyData.desc: Increments violationCount and returns the penalty data {type = 'liaison_deviation', amount, data = {violationNumber, recalcCount}} with amount = 30, 60, 120 then 180 s.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame by the manager. Every 10 s (manager.clock time), if recalcCount > 5 and violationCount < MAX_VIOLATIONS, calls manager:recordRouteRecalcPenalty(createPenaltyData()) and resets recalcCount to 0.

returns.desc: false if the 10 s window has not elapsed, otherwise nil.
